front: Valid values of `cloudFiles.format`
back: avro, binaryFile, csv, json, orc, parquet, text, xml. Delta và Iceberg không phải file format của Auto Loader.

front: Kinesis or Pub/Sub ingestion on Databricks
back: Structured Streaming or a Lakeflow pipeline (`format("kinesis")`, `read_pubsub`). Lakeflow Connect chưa có managed connector cho hai nguồn này.

front: Components of a Lakeflow Connect database connector
back: UC connection, ingestion gateway (classic, continuous), staging volume, ingestion pipeline (serverless), streaming tables. Gateway và pipeline tách nhau nhờ staging volume.

front: SQL Server change tracking vs CDC
back: Change tracking: needs primary key, lighter, SCD Type 1 only. CDC: no primary key needed, full history, needed for SCD Type 2.

front: Gateway stopped longer than log retention
back: Changes are lost; full refresh affected tables. Gateway phải chạy liên tục.

front: MySQL connector source prerequisites
back: Binary logging on, `binlog_format = ROW`, `binlog_row_image = FULL`, replication user. Connector đang Public Preview.

front: PostgreSQL connector source prerequisites
back: PostgreSQL 13+, `wal_level = logical` (RDS: `rds.logical_replication = 1`), publication then replication slot, REPLICA IDENTITY. Connector đang Public Preview.

front: Database has no CDC, only an `updated_at` column
back: Lakeflow Connect query-based connector: cursor column, no gateway, no staging, scheduled. Không bắt mọi trạng thái trung gian giữa hai lần chạy.

front: Make a pipeline streaming table readable by Iceberg clients
back: `pipelines.externalMetadata.enabled` plus UniForm Iceberg V3 properties; reader needs `EXTERNAL USE SCHEMA` and `SELECT`. Không cần copy data.

ref.label: Enable external data access to streaming tables and materialized views

front: OpenSharing former name
back: Delta Sharing; renamed OpenSharing in June 2026, hosted by the Linux Foundation. Docs mới chỉ dùng tên OpenSharing.

front: Databricks-to-Databricks vs Databricks-to-Open
back: D2D: recipient on Unity Catalog, sharing identifier, no token, volumes, models, notebooks. Open: any client, bearer token or OIDC, tabular data only.

front: `ALTER SHARE ... ADD TABLE ... WITH HISTORY`
back: Enables time travel, streaming reads and transactions for recipients; default on Databricks Runtime 16.2+. CDF qua `table_changes()` cần bật CDF trước khi share.

front: Clean Rooms trust model
back: No-trust: all collaborators equal, every notebook needs approval from the other party, max 10 collaborators. Packaged clean rooms là ngoại lệ provider-consumer.

front: Query federation vs catalog federation
back: Query federation pushes SQL to the database over JDBC; catalog federation reads foreign tables directly from object storage on Databricks compute. Catalog federation rẻ và nhanh hơn.

ref.label: Connect to external databases and catalogs

front: Privileges to create a foreign catalog
back: `CREATE CATALOG` on the metastore plus ownership of the connection or `CREATE FOREIGN CATALOG` on it. Tạo connection cần `CREATE CONNECTION` trên metastore.

front: Filter on a window function result in SQL
back: `QUALIFY`, e.g. `QUALIFY row_number() OVER (...) = 1`. Cần ít nhất một window function, không chứa aggregate.

front: What a VARIANT column cannot be used for
back: Partition, clustering or Z-order key, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, DISTINCT, set operators; no min/max stats. Tách field hay lọc thành cột thường.

ref.label: Variant type support for Iceberg and Delta Lake

front: `try_parse_json` and `try_variant_get`
back: Return NULL instead of failing on malformed JSON or failed casts. `parse_json` và `variant_get` báo lỗi.

ref.label: How is variant different than JSON strings?

front: Expectation actions
back: warn (default) keeps rows, drop removes them with metrics, fail rolls back the update without metrics. Quarantine dùng warn cộng cột cờ.

ref.label: Manage data quality with pipeline expectations

front: SQL Server integrated CDC pipeline vs gateway-based
back: One pipeline with `connection_name` and `connector_type: CDC`, extraction in each update; gateway-based uses a continuous gateway plus an ingestion pipeline. Integrated CDC tự tạo staging volume nếu không khai báo.

front: AG failover with SQL Server change tracking
back: Requires a full refresh of all tables in the pipeline. CDC qua AG listener thì resume được nhờ LSN checkpoint.

front: Automatic change data feed requirements
back: Databricks Runtime 19+, Unity Catalog table with row tracking (Delta) or Iceberg v3; no per-table property. Đọc bằng `readChangeFeed` hoặc `table_changes()` như CDF cũ.

front: Join hint priority when both sides have different hints
back: BROADCAST, then MERGE, then SHUFFLE_HASH, then SHUFFLE_REPLICATE_NL. Hint BROADCAST bỏ qua `autoBroadcastJoinThreshold`.
